title: Feelings
description: Say how you feel and respond when someone else does.

questions.sentence: Aap aaj kaise hain?
options: Main aaj bohot khush hoon.
Main aaj udaas hoon.
Main aaj ghar ja raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main aaj bohot khush hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am very happy today.

questions.sentence: Main bohot udaas hoon.
options: I am very sad.
I am very happy.
I am very tired.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very sad.

questions.sentence: Kya tum khush ho?
options: Haan, main bohot khush hoon.
Nahin, mera dil udaas hai.
Haan, main thak gaya hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main bohot khush hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very happy.

questions.sentence: Aaj mera dil khush hai.
options: I feel happy today.
I feel sad today.
I feel tired today.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel happy today.

questions.sentence: Kya aap theek hain?
options: Haan, main bilkul theek hoon.
Nahin, main aaj udaas hoon.
Haan, main ghar par hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main bilkul theek hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am absolutely fine.

questions.sentence: Woh bohot khush hai.
options: She is very happy.
She is very sad.
She is very quiet.
questions.correctAnswer: She is very happy.

questions.sentence: Yeh khabar bohot achhi hai.
options: Sun kar bohot khushi hui.
Sun kar bohot dukh hua.
Mujhe yeh khabar maloom nahin thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Sun kar bohot khushi hui.
questions.translatedSentence: I am very glad to hear it.

questions.sentence: Hum sab bohot khush hain.
options: We are all very happy.
We are all very tired.
They are all very happy.
questions.correctAnswer: We are all very happy.

questions.sentence: Main aaj thora udaas hoon.
options: Kya hua, sab theek hai?
Bohot bohot mubarak ho!
Main bhi aaj bohot khush hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Kya hua, sab theek hai?
questions.translatedSentence: What happened, is everything all right?

questions.sentence: Tum itne khamosh kyun ho?
options: Main bohot thak gaya hoon.
Main bohot khush hoon.
Main abhi ghar aaya hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main bohot thak gaya hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am very tired.

questions.sentence: Main aaj bohot thak gaya hoon.
options: I am very tired today.
I am very bored today.
I am very busy today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very tired today.

questions.sentence: Kya tum mujh se naraz ho?
options: Nahin, main naraz nahin hoon.
Haan, main bohot khush hoon.
Nahin, main ghar ja raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, main naraz nahin hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am not upset with you.

questions.sentence: Woh mujh par bohot gussa hai.
options: He is very angry with me.
He is very pleased with me.
He is very worried about me.
questions.correctAnswer: He is very angry with me.

questions.sentence: Yahan bohot andhera hai.
options: Mujhe thora dar lag raha hai.
Mujhe bohot khushi ho rahi hai.
Mujhe zor ki neend aa rahi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe thora dar lag raha hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I am feeling a little scared.

questions.sentence: Mujhe is film se dar lagta hai.
options: This film scares me.
This film bores me.
I like this film a lot.
questions.correctAnswer: This film scares me.

questions.sentence: Aaj ghar mein koi kaam nahin hai.
options: Mera dil bilkul nahin lag raha.
Mujhe bohot gussa aa raha hai.
Mujhe is ghar se dar lagta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mera dil bilkul nahin lag raha.
questions.translatedSentence: I am completely bored.

questions.sentence: Mujhe abhi neend aa rahi hai.
options: I am feeling sleepy right now.
I am feeling angry right now.
I am feeling scared right now.
questions.correctAnswer: I am feeling sleepy right now.

questions.sentence: Tumhein gussa kyun aaya?
options: Kyunki woh bohot der se aaya.
Kyunki main din bhar thak gaya.
Kyunki mujhe raat mein dar lagta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Kyunki woh bohot der se aaya.
questions.translatedSentence: Because he came very late.

questions.sentence: Main aaj kuch pareshan hoon.
options: Kya baat hai, aap theek hain?
Bohot khoob, mubarak ho!
Main abhi Karachi ja raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Kya baat hai, aap theek hain?
questions.translatedSentence: What is the matter, are you all right?

questions.sentence: Aap aaj thake hue lag rahe hain.
options: You look tired today.
You look happy today.
You look busy today.
questions.correctAnswer: You look tired today.

questions.sentence: Aap ka chehra utra hua hai.
options: Haan, tabiyat theek nahin hai.
Haan, aaj main bohot khush hoon.
Nahin, mujhe abhi neend aa rahi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, tabiyat theek nahin hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am not feeling well.

questions.sentence: Kya main aap se pooch sakta hoon ke kya hua hai?
options: May I ask you what has happened?
May I tell you what has happened?
Do you know what has happened?
questions.correctAnswer: May I ask you what has happened?

questions.sentence: Tum kal se khamosh ho, sab theek hai?
options: Haan, bas thora thak gaya hoon.
Nahin, main kal Delhi gaya tha.
Haan, mujhe biryani bohot pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, bas thora thak gaya hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am just a little tired.

questions.sentence: Mujhe bataiye ke aap ko kya pareshani hai.
options: Please tell me what is troubling you.
Please tell me where you are going.
Please ask me what the trouble is.
questions.correctAnswer: Please tell me what is troubling you.

questions.sentence: Aap ki tabiyat ab kaisi hai?
options: Pehle se behtar hai, shukriya.
Mujhe woh jagah maloom nahin hai.
Main kab se aap ka intezar kar raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Pehle se behtar hai, shukriya.
questions.translatedSentence: It is better than before, thank you.

questions.sentence: Tum aaj bohot khush lag rahe ho.
options: You look very happy today.
You look very tired today.
You seem very angry today.
questions.correctAnswer: You look very happy today.

questions.sentence: Kya aap ko kisi cheez ki zaroorat hai?
options: Zara ek pyala chai pila dijiye.
Mujhe aap se koi shikayat nahin hai.
Main aaj bohot udaas mehsoos kar raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Zara ek pyala chai pila dijiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Please get me a cup of tea.

questions.sentence: Mera imtihan bohot bura gaya.
options: Fikar mat karo, agli baar behtar hoga.
Bohot mubarak ho, main bohot khush hoon.
Mujhe imtihan ki tareekh maloom nahin thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Fikar mat karo, agli baar behtar hoga.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not worry, next time will be better.

questions.sentence: Fikar ki koi baat nahin hai.
options: There is nothing to worry about.
There is no time to talk about this.
There is no need to hurry.
questions.correctAnswer: There is nothing to worry about.

questions.sentence: Mujhe dar hai ke main yeh kaam nahin kar sakta.
options: Aap zaroor kar sakte hain, himmat rakhiye.
Haan, yeh kaam waqai bohot mushkil hai.
Mujhe bhi is kaam se dar lagta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Aap zaroor kar sakte hain, himmat rakhiye.
questions.translatedSentence: You can certainly do it, keep your courage up.

questions.sentence: Main hamesha aap ke saath hoon.
options: I am always with you.
I am always at home.
I will always ask you first.
questions.correctAnswer: I am always with you.

questions.sentence: Mere waalid ki tabiyat kharab hai.
options: Khuda un ko jald sehat de.
Bohot khoob, yeh to achhi khabar hai.
Mujhe un ka ghar maloom nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Khuda un ko jald sehat de.
questions.translatedSentence: May God grant them a quick recovery.

questions.sentence: Rona band karo, sab theek ho jayega.
options: Stop crying, everything will be fine.
Stop working, everything is ready.
Do not laugh, nothing is fine here.
questions.correctAnswer: Stop crying, everything will be fine.

questions.sentence: Main aaj kal bohot tanha mehsoos karta hoon.
options: Chalo, aaj sham chai peene chalte hain.
Main bhi aap se bohot naraz hoon.
Yeh kaam aap ko khud karna chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Chalo, aaj sham chai peene chalte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Come, let us go out for tea this evening.

questions.sentence: Aap ne bohot achha kaam kiya hai.
options: You have done very good work.
You have a lot of work to do.
You did not do this work well.
questions.correctAnswer: You have done very good work.

questions.sentence: Shukriya, aap ne mera hausla barha diya.
options: Koi baat nahin, hum dost hain.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe abhi jaana hai.
Meherbani, mujhe aap ki zaroorat thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahin, hum dost hain.
questions.translatedSentence: It is nothing, we are friends.

questions.sentence: Aap ko kaunsa khana pasand hai?
options: Mujhe Hyderabad ki biryani bohot pasand hai.
Mujhe khana pakana bilkul nahin aata.
Mujhe woh jagah pasand nahin aayi thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe Hyderabad ki biryani bohot pasand hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I really like Hyderabadi biryani.

questions.sentence: Mujhe sardi mein nihari khana pasand hai.
options: I like eating nihari in the winter.
I like drinking tea in the winter.
I do not like nihari in the winter.
questions.correctAnswer: I like eating nihari in the winter.

questions.sentence: Kya tumhein mushaira pasand hai?
options: Haan, mujhe shayari bohot pasand hai.
Nahin, mujhe raat ka khana pasand nahin.
Haan, main Lucknow mein rehta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, mujhe shayari bohot pasand hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I like poetry very much.

questions.sentence: Mujhe bohot shor pasand nahin hai.
options: I do not like a lot of noise.
I do not like a lot of sugar.
I quite like a bit of noise.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not like a lot of noise.

questions.sentence: Eid par tum kya karna chahte ho?
options: Main sab ke liye sheer khurma banana chahta hoon.
Mujhe Eid ki tareekh abhi maloom nahin.
Main us din bohot udaas ho gaya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Main sab ke liye sheer khurma banana chahta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I want to make sheer khurma for everyone.

questions.sentence: Mera dil chahta hai ke main Lucknow jaoon.
options: I feel like going to Lucknow.
I have to go to Lucknow today.
I do not want to go to Lucknow.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel like going to Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Aap ko chai chahiye ya kuch aur?
options: Bas ek pyala chai chahiye, shukriya.
Mujhe chai banani bilkul nahin aati.
Mujhe aap ki baat pasand nahin aayi.
questions.correctAnswer: Bas ek pyala chai chahiye, shukriya.
questions.translatedSentence: Just one cup of tea, thank you.

questions.sentence: Kaash mujhe Urdu achhi tarah aati.
options: I wish I knew Urdu well.
I know Urdu quite well now.
I wish I could teach Urdu here.
questions.correctAnswer: I wish I knew Urdu well.

questions.sentence: Mujhe garmi bilkul pasand nahin hai.
options: Mujhe bhi nahin, sardi kahin behtar hai.
Haan, garmi mein mera dil khush rehta hai.
Mujhe yeh khana bilkul pasand nahin aaya.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe bhi nahin, sardi kahin behtar hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Neither do I, winter is far better.

questions.sentence: Mere khayal mein yeh film bohot achhi thi.
options: Maaf kijiye, lekin mujhe woh pasand nahin aayi.
Bilkul, isi liye main aap se naraz hoon.
Haan, lekin mujhe film ka naam maloom nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Maaf kijiye, lekin mujhe woh pasand nahin aayi.
questions.translatedSentence: Excuse me, but I did not like it.

questions.sentence: Mujhe maaf kijiye, main jaan boojh kar der se nahin aaya.
options: Please forgive me, I did not come late on purpose.
Please forgive me, I came late on purpose.
Please excuse me, I cannot come at all today.
questions.correctAnswer: Please forgive me, I did not come late on purpose.

questions.sentence: Aap ke khayal mein humein abhi nikalna chahiye?
options: Haan, kyunki Karachi ka raasta bohot lamba hai.
Nahin, kyunki mujhe raasta maloom nahin hai.
Haan, kyunki mujhe andhere se dar lagta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, kyunki Karachi ka raasta bohot lamba hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, because the road to Karachi is very long.

questions.sentence: Agar aap ko meri baat buri lagi ho to main maafi chahta hoon.
options: If what I said upset you, I apologise.
If you are tired, I will come back later.
I am sorry that you did not say anything.
questions.correctAnswer: If what I said upset you, I apologise.

questions.sentence: Main aap ki baat se bilkul ittefaq nahin karta.
options: Koi baat nahin, har kisi ki apni raye hoti hai.
Shukriya, mujhe bhi bilkul yehi lagta hai.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe yeh baat maloom nahin thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahin, har kisi ki apni raye hoti hai.
questions.translatedSentence: That is all right, everyone has their own opinion.

questions.sentence: Main naraz nahin hoon, lekin mujhe thora dukh zaroor hua.
options: I am not angry, but I was certainly a little hurt.
I am angry, but I do not want to talk about it.
I am not angry, and nothing upset me at all.
questions.correctAnswer: I am not angry, but I was certainly a little hurt.

questions.sentence: Kal jo maine kaha tha, us ke liye mujhe sharmindagi hai.
options: Jaane dijiye, main to woh baat bhool bhi gaya.
Haan, is liye main abhi tak naraz hoon.
Mujhe aap ki baat samajh nahin aa rahi thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Jaane dijiye, main to woh baat bhool bhi gaya.
questions.translatedSentence: Let it go, I had already forgotten about it.

questions.sentence: Mujhe lagta hai ke hum dono thak gaye hain, is liye baat kal karte hain.
options: I think we are both tired, so let us talk tomorrow.
I think we are both happy, so let us talk tomorrow.
I think you are tired, so I will not speak to you again.
questions.correctAnswer: I think we are both tired, so let us talk tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Agar aap chahein to kal mil kar yeh baat khatam kar lete hain.
options: Theek hai, kal mulaqat mein sab saaf ho jayega.
Maaf kijiye, mujhe aap ka pata maloom nahin hai.
Nahin, kyunki mujhe woh khana pasand nahin tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, kal mulaqat mein sab saaf ho jayega.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, everything will be cleared up when we meet tomorrow.
